annotations.title: List the data tables of a Genesys connection

description:
List the data tables of a Genesys connection

Lists the data tables of the Genesys organization behind one of your Genesys connections, with `id` and `name`: the tables an agent can read, as the Genesys setup in the dashboard lists them. Use it to find a data table and its id; for queues use `list_genesys_queues`. Read only; each call asks Genesys live. `id` is a Genesys connection from `list_integrations`, 404 for any other connection. When Genesys cannot be asked, `ok` is false, the list is empty and `reason` says why: no sign in saved, sign in refused, permission missing or Genesys unreachable. `truncated` is true when there were more tables than one answer holds.
name: list_genesys_data_tables
title: List the data tables of a Genesys connection
